pages.title: Facebook pages
pages.text: The pages your posts go to. Connecting takes one click: sign in to Facebook and pick the pages.
pages.no_app: Facebook is not set up yet
pages.no_app_text: Your provider has to add their Meta app first. Ask them; then you can connect your pages here.
pages.empty_text: Connect your Facebook page to post products from here. You sign in through {app}.
pages.cannot_post: You cannot post on this page: ask an admin of the page to give you permission to create content, then connect again.
pages.needs_reconnect: Facebook no longer accepts this sign-in. Connect again so posts can go out.
pages.through_app: Pages connect through the Meta app "{app}".
pages.disconnect_text: Posts can no longer go to this page. Posts waiting for it go back to drafts; nothing is deleted.

outcome.expired: The Facebook sign-in took too long. Start connecting again.
outcome.cancelled: Connecting was cancelled on Facebook. Nothing changed.
outcome.failed: Facebook did not let us read your pages. Try again, and allow every permission asked for.

connect.title: Choose your pages
connect.text: Facebook showed us the pages you manage. Tick the ones to connect.
connect.none_text: Your Facebook account does not manage any page, or none was allowed. Connect again and allow the pages.
connect.cannot_post: You may not create posts on this page.
connect.renew: Already connected here; this renews its sign-in.

list.title: Facebook posts
list.text: Product posts written here, approved and put on your Facebook pages at their time.
list.no_pages_text: Posts go to a connected page. It takes one click.
list.empty_text: Write a post to show your products on Facebook.

post.title: Facebook post
post.text: What you write here goes to the page as shown on the right.
post.unschedule: Stop and take back to draft
post.reject_text: Say what to change; the writer sees it and can send the post again.
post.delete_text: The post and its photos are removed. This cannot be undone.
post.message_hint: Products you add put their line here; change it as you like.
post.when_hint: Empty: as soon as it is approved. A time must be at least {minutes} minutes from now.
post.find_product: Find a product by name or code
post.no_photos: No photos yet. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB each.
